title: warcraft-learner spec rulebook
description: AI-generated rulebook for a single WoW specialization. Extract all major offensive cooldowns, all personal defensive cooldowns, and 5-10 high-signal rotation/cooldown usage rules from the supplied guide content. Output ONLY the raw JSON object - no markdown fences, no preamble. The first character must be '{' and the last must be '}'.

spec.description: WCL spec name, e.g. SubtletyRogue. Must match the spec being analysed.

major_cooldowns.description: All major cooldowns: abilities with a cooldown >= 30s that meaningfully affect damage output (or healing/tanking if applicable). Include on-use trinkets when the guide mentions specific timing for them.

defensives.description: REQUIRED and must be populated. Every personal defensive cooldown with a cooldown >= 15s: immunities, absorb shields, significant damage reductions (>= 20%), and meaningful self-heals. Do NOT include passive talents or stance toggles.

rules.description: 5-10 high-signal rotation and cooldown usage rules: when to pair abilities, when to hold for Bloodlust, opener sequence, phase notes, pooling requirements, etc. Omit rules that are obvious, low-priority, or not checkable from cast timing alone.

source_summary.description: 2-3 sentences summarising the cooldown strategy these guides recommend.

guide_count.description: Added automatically by the admin CLI on save - do not populate manually.

saved_at.description: Added automatically by the admin CLI on save - do not populate manually.

name.description: Exact ability name as it appears in-game.

spell_id.description: WoW spell ID - REQUIRED. Prioritize the Active Ability Cast ID rather than a passive Aura, Classic WoW ID, or Talent Node ID. Verify at wowhead.com/spell=<id>. If genuinely unsure, supply your best guess and record the uncertainty in id_note - NEVER in usage_rule, which is shown to users as coaching copy.

duration.description: Optional. Active buff/window duration in seconds.

align_with_bloodlust.description: true if the guide explicitly says to sync this with Bloodlust / Heroism / Time Warp. Default false if the guide does not mention it.

opener_priority.description: Optional. Cast order in the opener (1 = first). Only set if the guide specifies a sequence.

usage_rule.description: One sentence: when and how to use this cooldown.

id_note.description: Optional. Internal maintainer note for any spell-ID uncertainty (e.g. 'best guess for the Midnight X cast, verify on Wowhead'). NEVER shown to users and not read by any analysis - put verification/best-guess notes here instead of in usage_rule.

talent_gated.description: Optional. Set to true when this ability requires a specific talent that not all builds take. When true, having zero casts is treated as normal rather than a 'never used' error.

spell_id.description: WoW spell ID - REQUIRED, same rule as major_cooldowns.

usage_rule.description: One sentence: when/why to press this button.

id_note.description: Optional. Internal maintainer note for any spell-ID uncertainty (e.g. 'best guess for the Midnight X cast, verify on Wowhead'). NEVER shown to users and not read by any analysis - put verification/best-guess notes here instead of in usage_rule.

talent_gated.description: Optional. Set to true when this ability requires a specific talent that not all builds take.

type.description: Rule category. cooldown_pairing: two abilities must be cast together or in sequence. cd_hold: an ability should be delayed until an anchor cooldown is available. opener: specific sequence or timing required at pull. rotation: ongoing priority or combo maintained throughout the fight. positioning: player must be in a specific location (melee range, behind target, etc.). aoe_switch: behavior changes when multiple targets are present.

priority.description: critical (fundamentally breaks the spec if ignored), high (major DPS loss), medium (moderate optimization), low (minor min-maxing).

description.description: Short rule title shown in the UI (<= 60 chars).

condition.description: Machine-readable trigger. Use null when the rule does not map cleanly to a supported kind. Rules with condition null are never auto-detected - they surface as display-only text, so only include them if the action alone is worth showing to the player.

action.description: Second-person prescriptive instruction. Must tell the player what to DO, not describe what the rule checks. Good: 'Always cast Secret Technique within 5s of Shadow Dance.' Bad: 'Shadow Dance was cast without Secret Technique beforehand.'

castWithoutPrior.description: Flag each cast of spell_id that is not paired with required_spell_id within window_s seconds.

spell_id.description: The spell whose casts are checked.

required_spell_id.description: The companion spell that must precede/accompany spell_id.

window_s.description: Seconds within which the required spell must appear.

exception.description: Optional. Exempt casts that occur within a specific context window (e.g. during a major 2-minute cooldown window).

holdCooldownForAnchor.description: Flag casts of spell_ids that land within hold_window_s seconds before a non-opener cast of anchor_spell_id.

spell_ids.description: Spells that should be held for the anchor.

anchor_spell_id.description: The anchor cooldown the spells should be saved for.

hold_window_s.description: Seconds before the anchor cast within which the held spells are flagged.
